item.title: Eight-month suspended sentence after man admits stealing steel beams in Marsaxlokk
item.description: Man handed 18-month prison sentence suspended for three years, after admitting to stealing steel beams from a property in Marsaxlokk

item.title: Annual fatalities rise sharply in 2025
item.description: Figures from the National Statistics Office show fewer crashes and injuries in the last three months of 2025, but road deaths climb to 18

item.title: Man jailed after threatening partner while skipping bail for Gozo Carnival
item.description: Simon Leyton Rachid acquitted of vehicle theft but found guilty of breaching bail and issuing death threats to his partner, with Magistrate Donatella Frendo Dimech lambasting his ‘lack of respect’ for the court after he drove his partner’s BMW to Gozo’s Carnival while claiming to be too ill to comply with bail conditions

item.title: Alex Borg meets MaltaToday: Opposition Leader warns PM not to delay chief justice appointment
item.description: PN leader says trust with government has been strained over proposed nomination, insists talks must not become a ‘political game’

item.title: Marsaxlokk Local Council objects to relocation of pig farm to Tas-Silġ
item.description: The pig farm in question is currently located in a residential area in Ħal Għaxaq

item.title: Momentum calls for reform after chimpanzee held in Swieqi rooftop cage heard screaming
item.description: Momentum claims a chimpanzee is being kept in dire conditions on a rooftop in Swieqi, and is calling on authorities to act after a previous fine of just €2 per day failed to resolve the situation

item.title: Dead body found at sea off Fomm ir-Riħ
item.description: Police investigating the discovery of a body at sea in the area of Fomm ir-Riħ

item.title: Cryptocurrency investment company engineer guilty of gaining access to its software ‘DNA’
item.description: Former cryptocurrency investment company engineer pleads guilty to gaining access to its software ‘at the highest level’ for malicious intent

item.title: Farmers fume as Malta Marathon forces Sunday closure of pitkalija
item.description: Farmers left frustrated after being told the Malta Marathon will force the closure of the Ta’ Qali pitkalija on Sunday, leaving them concerned that the move will impact them negatively financially

item.title: Xaxa Calleja: We associate white space with being empty but, is that space really empty?
